data.name: SitterEveryVisit
data.value: Check it each time you visit

data.name: SitterFineUntilBack
data.value: Should be fine until you're back

data.comment: Heading of the box with the checking rules on the plant-sitter sheet.

data.name: SitterMeterAt
data.value: Water only at {0} or below on the meter.
data.comment: {0} is a number from 0 to 10.

data.name: SitterPaceReservoir
data.value: Usually needs topping up about every {0} days. Check the level first, and leave it if there's still water in it.

data.name: SitterPaceKnown
data.value: Usually dry enough to need water about every {0} days. Check it first, and leave it if it's still damp.

data.name: SitterPaceUnknown
data.value: Not learned yet, so check it every visit.

data.name: SitterMeter
data.value: There's a moisture meter. Push it into the soil about halfway down and read the number. Water only if it reads at or below the number on the plant's card. If it's higher, leave it: it's fine until your next visit.

data.name: SitterMeterIn
data.value: There's a moisture meter, {0}. Push it into the soil about halfway down and read the number. Water only if it reads at or below the number on the plant's card. If it's higher, leave it: it's fine until your next visit.
data.comment: {0} is where the meter is, typed by the person.

data.name: SitterNoReading
data.value: No reading? Push a finger 2 to 3 cm into the soil, and water only if it's dry all the way down.

data.name: SitterFinger
data.value: Push a finger 2 to 3 cm into the soil. Water only if it's dry all the way down. If it's damp, or you're not sure, leave it. It's safe to wait until your next visit.

data.name: SitterTopUpOnly
data.value: Plants in water or on a reservoir only need topping up.

data.name: SitterDates
data.comment: The dates of the time away in the header of the sheet.

data.name: MethodTop
data.comment: The short name of a way of watering, on a plant-sitter card.

data.name: MethodHintNone
data.value: The sheet for a plant-sitter uses the way you pick when you make it.

data.name: MethodHintTop
data.value: Pour water onto the soil until a little runs out below.

data.name: MethodHintSoak
data.value: Stand the whole pot in a bowl of water for a while, then let it drain.

data.name: MethodHintBottom
data.value: Stand it in a saucer of water and let it soak up what it needs.

data.name: MethodStepsTop
data.value: Water from the top until a little runs out below. After 15 to 30 minutes, look in the saucer. If it's all been taken up, give a bit more and check again. Pour away what's left.

data.name: MethodStepsSoak
data.value: Stand the whole pot in a bowl of water for 15 to 30 minutes, then let it drain well.

data.name: MethodStepsBottom
data.value: Stand it in a saucer of water. After 15 to 30 minutes, see if it has taken it all up. If it has, give it a little more and check again after another 15 to 30 minutes. Once it stops taking water up, pour away what's left.

data.name: SitterDayFormat
data.comment: A .NET date pattern, like 23 December.

data.name: SitterLongDayFormat
data.comment: A .NET date pattern, like Tuesday 23 December. Text in quotes is kept as it is.

data.name: SitterShortDayFormat
data.comment: A .NET date pattern, like Tue 23.

data.name: SitterTextVisit
data.comment: A line of the shared sheet text. {0} is a date like Tuesday 23 December, {1} a number.

data.name: SitterTextCheckOn
data.comment: {0} is a list of dates.

data.name: TourTodayText
data.value: What needs doing turns up here. The coleus and its cuttings are an example, so try anything on them.

data.name: TourPlantText
data.value: Each plant opens on its photos and notes, newest first. The marked buttons add a photo, a note or care.

data.name: TourCuttingText
data.value: A cutting you're rooting is a propagation. It keeps where it came from, what it's rooting in and how many days it has taken. When it has rooted, it becomes a plant of its own.

data.name: TourWateringText
data.value: Tick what you watered as you go round. Stikling learns from what you log and asks you to check a plant when it's probably dry.

data.name: TourDataText
data.value: Everything is kept on this device, and you don't need an account. Save a backup or a spreadsheet whenever you like, or import yours to bring your plants in.
